_comment: Still image for each example on the Examples page (paths relative to content/); build.sh reads this. Examples without an entry are listed without a picture.

sod.alt: Density, velocity and pressure of the Sod shock tube against the exact solution

riemann_2d.alt: Density and numerical schlieren of the 2D Riemann problem on triangles at t = 0.8

riemann_2d_quads.alt: Density and numerical schlieren of the 2D Riemann problem on quadrilaterals at t = 0.8

double_mach.alt: Density and numerical schlieren of the double Mach reflection at t = 0.2

wedge.alt: Pressure over the 8 degree ramp with the theoretical oblique shock

cylinder.alt: Vorticity in the wake of the cylinder at Re = 100

viscous_shock_tube.alt: Density near the floor of the viscous shock tube at t = 1 and wall density against the reference

explosion_3d.alt: Density of every cell of the 3D spherical explosion against radius, on a 1D reference

mallard.alt: Mach number of Mach 8 flow over a flying mallard at t = 0.75

taylor_green_3d.alt: Q-criterion isosurfaces of the Taylor-Green vortex and its dissipation rate against the spectral DNS

sphere_mach3.alt: Mach 3 flow over a sphere with the bow-shock standoff against Billig's correlation

sedov_3d.alt: Sedov-Taylor blast wave on three symmetry planes with the shock radius against the similarity solution

shu_osher.alt: Density of the Shu-Osher problem against a fine-grid reference

sphere_re300.alt: Hairpin vortices shed by a sphere at Re = 300
